Hi! ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ

I'm Monique, a current graduate student pursuining a Master in Environmental Data Science at the Bren School of Environmental Science and Managment located within the University of California Santa Barbara (UCSB). Besides my interest to advocate for environmental justice, I enjoy discovering new vegan restaurants, practicing my non-primary languages (Spanish, French, and Korean), and learning new skills, such as djing, filmmaking, and (of course) coding! To learn more check out my [about me](about.qmd) or browse through my past projects.
